$note: The catalogue that ships with Jarvis: this folder's own skills, so a fresh install has something to browse. It is read through the same file:// path an operator's folder is (extensions/catalog.py read_local_catalog) and it is NOT a list of remote origins — every url below is a folder beside this file, inside the package that is already running. Descriptions, versions and permissions are copied from each SKILL.md and tests/test_extensions.py holds them equal; the ref is the skill's version, since the bundle has no tags of its own.
